item.title: Weekly AI News Summary
item.description:
Weekly AI News Summary

OpenAI's Next Gen AI and Academic Acclaim

OpenAI introduces Next Gen AI, promising boosted performance for developers, while Sutton & Barto win the prestigious Turing Award in RL. Meanwhile, QwQ's 32B reasoning model aims to elevate math and code skills.

AI Innovation Galore

From pipeline parallelism improvements to layout-to-image generation, AI research is blooming. While Infrared Image Super-Resolution dazzles with enhanced visual fidelity, the AI community unveils novel high-quality audio compression techniques.

item.title: Porn
item.description:
Porn addiction

Considering this is my first blog post, it will be rather heavy. But it's important to me, and I'd be happy if I could help or even inspire anyone to conquer this horrible addiction.

When porn becomes the teacher

I was exposed to porn much sooner than I would've liked (I thought the complete opposite back then). At the age of 15, I watched my first pornographic video. At the time, I didn't have a proper introduction to sex, so you could call this my sexual education.
